sources.title: 本人relative margin逐步推導
sources.details: {"margin_example": {"reference": [-4, -3], "policy": [-3, -3], "steps": ["reference=-4-(-3)=-1", "policy=-3-(-3)=0", "relative=0-(-1)=1"]}, "same_start": "若πθ=πref，則每篇候選的log比值為0，m=(a-b)-(a-b)=0；不要求a=b。每步計分前重新從當前policy複製reference會再次得到0，失去相對原始πref的固定anchor。", "negative_margin": "m_policy=logP(chosen|prompt)-logP(rejected|prompt)<0 ⇔ P(chosen|prompt)<P(rejected|prompt)，因log單調遞增。改善m_relative>0並不推出m_policy>0。", "formal_arithmetic": {"reference": -10.893460392951965, "policy": -8.447893142700195, "relative": 2.44556725025177, "rounded_5_decimal": ["-10.89346", "-8.44789", "2.44557"]}, "beta": "L=-logσ(βm); dL/dm=-βσ(-βm)。β在非線性內縮放margin，optimizer的learning rate在得到gradient後縮放step，二者不能混稱；這裡沒有宣称β越大完整訓練越好。"}
